title.en: Which mortar sprayer is printed for no 380 V?
title.zh: 没有 380V 时，印了哪台砂浆喷涂机？

description.en: Type 511 diesel: diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, ≤ 6 mm, 30 m / 15 m, 360 kg. Engine kW and HP are not printed on that sheet.
description.zh: 511 柴油机：柴油机、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m、360 kg。该页没有印出发动机千瓦或马力。

h1.en: Which mortar sprayer is printed for no 380 V?
h1.zh: 没有 380V 时，印了哪台砂浆喷涂机？

directAnswer.en: Type 511 diesel, for the 3 m³/h mortar window. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints a diesel engine, 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, hose 32/38 mm, mixing ratio ≤ 1:3, particle ≤ 6 mm, 30 m / 15 m, 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm and 360 kg. The sheet does not print engine kilowatts or horsepower. Do not borrow 28/32 HP from the diesel concrete sprayer or 7.5 kW from electric Type 511.
directAnswer.zh: 511 柴油机，对应 3 m³/h 的砂浆窗口。邢台河北品锦机械印了柴油机、3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、管径 32/38 mm、砂灰比 ≤ 1:3、粒径 ≤ 6 mm、30 m / 15 m、外形 1600 × 1200 × 450 mm、360 kg。该页没有印发动机千瓦或马力。不要向柴油混凝土喷涂机借 28/32 HP，也不要向电动 511 借 7.5 kW。

heading.zh: 同一个砂浆窗口，不同的机器

body.en: Electric Type 511 is 7.5 kW, 260 kg and 1700 × 550 × 900 mm on 380 V. The diesel page keeps 3 m³/h, 3–5 MPa, ≤ 6 mm and 30 m / 15 m, and changes the power, the mass and the frame. Sites that do have 380 V should use the electric page.
body.zh: 电动 511 是 380V 上的 7.5 kW、260 kg、1700 × 550 × 900 mm。柴油页保留 3 m³/h、3–5 MPa、≤ 6 mm 和 30 m / 15 m，并改了动力、质量和机架。现场有 380V 时应用电动那一页。

heading.en: The 5 m³/h diesel sprayer is coarser work
heading.zh: 5 m³/h 的柴油喷涂机是另一档

body.en: The diesel concrete spraying machine prints 28/32 HP, 5 m³/h, 8 MPa, ≤ 6 mm and 80 m / 40 m at 480 kg. Use it when the job is that concrete-sprayer row, not when you only needed the 3 m³/h mortar window without 380 V.
body.zh: 柴油混凝土喷涂机印的是 28/32 HP、5 m³/h、8 MPa、≤ 6 mm、80 m / 40 m、480 kg。作业对得上那一行混凝土喷涂时才用它，而不是只要无 380V 的 3 m³/h 砂浆窗口。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Do not ask for an engine kilowatt figure this sheet does not print. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 不要索取这一页没有印出的发动机千瓦数。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: Yes, the same hose cell as electric Type 511.
answer.zh: 是，和电动 511 的软管格相同。

question.en: Can it replace a Diesel 30 trailer pump?

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 is a 15 m³/h concrete pipeline pump.
answer.zh: 不能。柴油30是 15 m³/h 的混凝土管道泵。

question.en: Is 360 kg shared with the German type?

answer.en: Both print 360 kg. The German type is 380 V, 7.5/9 kW, 3–5 m³/h, 8 MPa and ≤ 5 mm. The weight match is not the same machine.
answer.zh: 两台都印了 360 kg。德式机是 380V、7.5/9 kW、3–5 m³/h、8 MPa、≤ 5 mm。重量相同不是同一台机器。
